title: OPT-C / OPT-D Downstream Evaluation
objective: Materialise lawful GET/read-only downstream evaluation presentation for frozen-candidate OPT-C neutral consequences and OPT-D comparative evidence without allowing downstream evidence to repair, rewrite or promote upstream candidate identity.
owner_sources: OPT-C owner source if/when materialised and lawful
OPT-D owner source if/when materialised and lawful
required_artifacts: OPT-C and OPT-D source-authority preflight performed independently
GET-only API route and generated client where lawful
candidate non-repair and Validation denial-before-resolution evidence
acceptance_conditions: Frozen candidate identity is preserved exactly.
Downstream evaluation cannot repair, erase or mutate discovery/candidate generations.
OPT-C and OPT-D presentation authority are resolved independently and are non-transitive.
Validation remains locked/separate and protected identifiers are denied before resolution.
GET/read-only and authority delta NONE are preserved.
rollback: Forward-disable/revert only WP5C2 Console bindings; preserve frozen candidates, OPT-C/OPT-D owner evidence and history.
